authoring_method: Original procedural 3D surface authoring in standard C++20
reference_usage: Visual shape and palette reference only; not loaded as a texture or reconstructed automatically
body: Profiled torso, narrow waist, shaped head surface with integrated nose, modeled eyes/lids/lips/ears and pale cool skin
hair: Black crown shell, tapered volumetric fringe, side locks, long back locks and small side-braid shapes
clothing_and_equipment: double-sided cape with muted gold trim
native_skinning: CPU linear blend, bind-world inverse matrices, up to 2 authored nonzero influences in 4 storage slots
glb_export: Same bound vertices, normals, vertex colors, material groups, joints, weights and inverse binds as the native model; glTF 2.0 binary
runtime: shared C++ core / SDL3 3.4.20 GPU; reviewed on macOS Metal
renderer: Basic diffuse, fill, material-dependent specular and rim approximation; not a complete PBR or shadow renderer
